content.value_statement: Growing pipeline across paid, SEO, and partner channels is hard to coordinate. This skill gives structured campaign playbooks, benchmarks, and CAC guidance for B2B SaaS acquisition.
actual_capabilities: Build full-funnel campaign briefs with objectives, budgets, audiences, offers, metrics, and HubSpot setup fields.
Provide channel playbooks for LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, partnerships, and affiliate programs.
Recommend B2B SaaS CAC benchmarks, budget allocation, scaling rules, and handoff metrics.
Guide HubSpot campaign tracking, UTM planning, lead scoring, attribution reports, and partner source fields.
Run a local Python CAC calculator using editable channel spend and customer inputs.
Create experiment templates for A/B tests, sample size planning, and performance dashboard reviews.
limitations: Benchmarks are generalized for Series A B2B SaaS and need validation against current account data.
The skill does not connect directly to ad platforms, HubSpot, GA4, or Search Console.
Some referenced resource files and extra calculators are listed in the guide but are not included in this package.
It cannot guarantee campaign performance or legal compliance for every market.

use_cases.title: Launch a Full-Funnel Campaign
use_cases.description: Create a campaign brief, channel mix, UTM plan, lead scoring model, and sales handoff plan for a pipeline target.

use_cases.title: Optimize Paid Acquisition Spend
use_cases.description: Compare LinkedIn, Google, Meta, and retargeting tactics against CAC targets and conversion benchmarks.

use_cases.title: Build an Acquisition Operating Model
use_cases.description: Define attribution reports, partner tracking, experiment cadence, and monthly executive dashboard metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Campaign Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single demand campaign.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a demand generation campaign brief for [product], [audience], [region], [budget], and [pipeline goal]. Include channels, offer, metrics, and HubSpot setup.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Channel Budget
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for budget allocation and benchmarks.
prompt_templates.prompt: Allocate [monthly budget] across LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, SEO, partnerships, and experiments for a Series A B2B SaaS company. Explain CAC assumptions and scaling rules.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Acquisition Performance
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for performance review and optimization.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these acquisition metrics: [metrics]. Identify underperforming channels, likely causes, reporting gaps, and the next five tests to improve SQL volume.

prompt_templates.title: Build an International Launch Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for regional expansion planning.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 90-day acquisition launch plan for [region] with paid media, SEO, partnerships, localization, attribution, and sales handoff steps.

output_examples.input: Plan a $40,000 monthly acquisition program for a Series A B2B SaaS company selling to engineering leaders.
output: LinkedIn receives the largest share for account targeting and senior titles.
Google Search captures high-intent category and competitor demand.
SEO and partnerships receive steady investment for lower CAC pipeline.
The plan includes SQL targets, CAC guardrails, and weekly optimization reviews.

output_examples.input: Prepare a HubSpot tracking plan for a LinkedIn ABM campaign.
output: Create one HubSpot campaign record for the ABM program.
Use consistent UTM values for source, medium, campaign, content, and term.
Add lead scoring for downloads, demo requests, company size, and title fit.
Report by channel, campaign, region, funnel stage, SQL rate, and pipeline value.

output_examples.input: Find the next experiments for a paid acquisition program with rising CAC.
output: Pause campaigns with CAC above target and weak conversion quality.
Test landing page offers, audience exclusions, creative angles, and demo CTAs.
Prioritize tests with high impact, strong confidence, and low implementation effort.

best_practices: Validate benchmarks against your CRM, ad platform data, sales cycle, and average contract value.
Use consistent UTM names and campaign IDs before comparing channel performance.
Review CAC, SQL rate, pipeline value, and lead quality together before reallocating spend.
anti_patterns: Do not scale paid spend only because lead volume increased.
Do not use one campaign structure for every region without localization checks.
Do not treat first-touch attribution as the full source of pipeline truth.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: Demand generation, paid media, SEO, partnerships, and revenue teams at B2B SaaS companies can use it.

faq.question: Does it connect to HubSpot or ad platforms?
faq.answer: No. It gives setup guidance and reporting structures, but it does not call external platform APIs.

faq.question: Can it calculate CAC?
faq.answer: Yes. The package includes a simple Python calculator for blended and channel-specific CAC.

faq.question: Is it limited to Series A companies?
faq.answer: No. The examples focus on Series A B2B SaaS, but teams can adapt the frameworks for other stages.

faq.question: Does it replace legal or privacy review?
faq.answer: No. Teams should review GDPR, consent, advertising, and data handling requirements for each market.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible workflows.
